title: Deviation
description: One special condition, ELOS/ESF, exemption or deviation as its regulator lists it. Link-only: the text stays at source_url. Lives at deviations/{issuer}/{key}.json.

key.description: Stable identity within the issuer; the file name. EASA: the publication page's node id. FAA: the DRS document id.

number.description: The identifier as printed (`SC-E25.904-01`), or null when the listing prints none. Not unique.

title.description: As listed, verbatim; null when the listing prints none (FAA exemptions).

source_url.description: The regulator's page for this record. Required: a record is a link.

model.description: Model(s) as listed; several joined with ' | '.

regulation_ref.description: The listing's regulation field as listed (FAA DRS: CFR Section Reference; exemptions: Regulation/Title 14 CFR Reference), several values joined with ' | '. Citations and gaps may be read from it.

final.description: On a proposed record: the key of the final record it became (same issuer and kind).

citations.description: Sections the title or identifier names, read by the tools. Never a statement that the deviation applies to them.

listed.description: A value as the regulator's listing prints it, verbatim.

citation.description: One cited provision, by its number at the latest revision.
